silence_the_bell.title: The Bell Below
silence_the_bell.description: A drowned bell has rung for three nights beneath the Lantern Reef, and the dead are walking the tide caves. Keeper Mara wants the Bell Warden ended before the village loses the reef.
silence_the_bell.objective: Defeat the Bell Warden in the bell chamber beneath the tide caves.

drowned_names.title: The Drowned Names
drowned_names.description: Archivist Orin is still entering the names of the crews lost when the bell first rang. The last ship's log is somewhere in the tide caves.
drowned_names.objective: Recover the Drowned Man's Log from the tide caves and return it to Orin.

salt_and_iron.title: Salt and Iron
salt_and_iron.description: Smith Halla wants the bronze clapper from the Sunken Bell, enough old metal to forge a blade that will hold against the Warden.
salt_and_iron.objective: Recover the Bell Clapper from the bell chamber and return it to Halla.
